verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs claim it can 'Instantly verify 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories' and describe document-based verification as part of configurable levels, showing broad claimed coverage. However, the evidence does not surface an actual published, browsable list of supported countries/document types (passports, IDs, licenses, permits explicitly enumerated), nor a link to such a reference page. missing for 10: a concrete published country/document-type list, explicit breakdown by document category (passport vs ID vs license vs residence permit), independent verification of the 220+/14,000+ claim.
